mapper.sql: order_id, user_id, order_no, trade_group, group_key, goods_amount, freight_amount, discount_amount, payable_amount, address_snapshot, payment_channel, order_status, stock_locked_until, paid_at, cancelled_at, shipped_at, completed_at, remark, source, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mall_order ( order_id, user_id, order_no, trade_group, group_key, goods_amount, freight_amount, discount_amount, payable_amount, address_snapshot, payment_channel, order_status, stock_locked_until, remark, source ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{userId}, #{orderNo}, #{tradeGroup}, #{groupKey}, #{goodsAmount}, #{freightAmount}, #{discountAmount}, #{payableAmount}, #{addressSnapshot}, #{paymentChannel}, #{orderStatus}, #{stockLockedUntil}, #{remark}, #{source} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM mall_order WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE mall_order SET order_status = 'PAID', payment_channel = #{paymentChannel}, paid_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND order_status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT'
UPDATE mall_order SET order_status = 'CANCELLED', cancelled_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND order_status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT'
UPDATE mall_order SET order_status = 'SHIPPED', shipped_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND order_status = 'PAID'
UPDATE mall_order SET order_status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND order_status = 'SHIPPED'
